title: Major Building Entrances
previewText:
Any development or enlargement with a commercial floor area ratio of 5.0 or greater and located on a zoning lot with frontage upon Hudson Boulevard shall provide a major entranceway to the commercial portion of the building on Hudson Boulevard.

blocks.html: The street wall of any building facing east towards Ninth Avenue south of West 33rd Street shall contain either a major building entrance or have at least 70 percent of its ground floor frontage occupied by retail uses.
